0022600135.text: The Philadelphia 76ers (3-1, 2nd in the Atlantic and 4th in the East) head into their fifth game of the season after a loss in their most recent outing, while the Indiana Pacers (2-2, 3rd in the Central and 8th in the East) are also coming off a loss. Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), Dominick Barlow (back, fracture), Jabari Walker (knee, soreness) and Tacko Fall (quadriceps, strain), and Indiana is missing Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery) and T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain), with Aaron Nesmith, Andrew Nembhard, Obi Toppin and Tyrese Haliburton listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions. The 76ers won the 2025-26 season series 4-0 and their most recent meeting, on April 10, 2026 in Indianapolis, 105-94, and no games have been played yet in the 2026-27 season series.
